findings.text: the dry-run preview calls measurement_flag_refusal without the node's role, while the launch at preparation.py:726 passes role=str(node.role or "") and accepts a review of a declared-done section through the carve-out at preparation.py:307, so a --dry-run --role review of a done section exits 2 although the dispatch it previews would launch; the carve-out has no test either way.

the reflex case's guard is the prose assertion on report reason at tests/test_a_measurement_run_never_lands.py:345, not the structural flag the refusal sets at recovery_review_dispatch.py:3375, so the recorded control reddens it only because the fallback liveness reason lacks the word measurement: a rewording of the measurement refusal would redden it against correct code.

the measure_only key is parsed by three separate definitions with three tolerances: _measurement_reason here, _measurement_run_skip at queue_landing.py:1928 and _is_measurement_run at recovery_review_dispatch.py:3341, so the reflex, the lander and the promotion can disagree about one run.

an unreadable plan answers "" so the guard is skipped, which makes the one case where the declaration cannot be established the case where a declared-done section stays dispatchable without the flag, and no case drives that path.
